name: Verifed V21
description: Redesigns Verifed with Source Serif 4/Public Sans typography, a shared warm-neutral/coral/green palette, clearer navigation and task-focused copy. Home adds working restaurant/dish/ingredient search and photo-led menus. Journal adds real counts, rating filters and clearer meal rows/editor. Scan keeps the requested fixed 15-dish Spanish translation, with clearer prices and source-page review; it is not live OCR or AI translation. Preserves existing restaurant logos and owner-scoped data. V20 remains unchanged.
verification: 168 automated tests passed, including palette contrast, new font provenance/loading, ingredient search, fixed Spanish menu text/prices, dietary filters, ownership and persistence.
Final iOS, Android and web JavaScript exports succeeded. All 356 food images, the original Spanish menu image, five new font faces and both Home photos matched source bytes in every platform export.

Browser verified Home search, changing the query then opening a restaurant and returning without resetting it, Chipotle navigation, local meal save/detail and rating-filter action, and the fixed Spanish photo upload/language toggle/save flow.
Browser screenshots reviewed Home, onboarding and Journal at 390px and 320px. Computed scan heading/input fonts were HomeHeadingStrong/HomeBody. No error logs were recorded in the direct-app check.

Independent design, typography and copy reviews were completed. Their search-state, ingredient-index, chain-font and compact-header findings were addressed. Research and related-code guides are included.
Physical iPhone camera/permissions, Expo Go, native text scaling and remote Snack runtime remain unverified. No live AI provider or backend deployment is included.
remoteRuntimeVerification: Not verified on a physical iPhone or remote Snack runtime
